description.content:
Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) API — the public web service operated by the Research Division of the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. Provides programmatic access to 800,000+ economic time series across Categories, Releases, Series, Sources, and Tags endpoint families plus the underlying Series Observations endpoint that returns the actual time-series values. All endpoints accept an api_key, optional realtime_start / realtime_end parameters (ALFRED vintages), and a file_type parameter (xml | json).

Contact Support:
 Name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis — Research Division
